description: This file defines the DocumentRelations class which provides methods for navigating and querying hierarchical relationships between document objects within the MigraDoc library.

classes.name: DocumentRelations
classes.description: Provides relational information between document objects, including methods to check for parent objects of specific types and retrieve parents in the document hierarchy.

methods.name: HasParentOfType
methods.description: Determines whether the specified document object has a parent of a given type somewhere within the hierarchy.

methods.name: GetParent
methods.description: Returns the direct parent of the given document object.

methods.name: GetParentOfType
methods.description: Recursively searches up the hierarchy to find a parent of a specified type, returning null if none exists.
